A critical detail: **a TT-30 outlet doesn't mean the station can deliver the full 30 amps.** The AC200L's 2,400W inverter supplies about 20 amps at 120V. It's suitable for essential RV loads, but not running every appliance simultaneously.

Also, turn off the RV converter when appropriate to avoid wasting battery energy charging the RV's house battery through the power station.

## Where to buy

The supplied comparison lists an official-store affiliate purchase link:

<Link url="https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac200l" title="BLUETTI AC200L — listed $899, use AFF5OFF for 5% off"/>

**Bottom line:** Choose the **BLUETTI AC200L** if you want a ready-to-use RV station with strong solar charging. Choose the **Growatt INFINITY 2000 PRO at $676.16** if maximizing battery capacity per dollar matters more.

One question that could change my recommendation: **Are you planning to plug your RV's 30-amp shore-power cord directly into the power station, or just plug individual appliances into it?**
